name: Spherical Binoctree
definition: A sphere-shaped octree structure that subdivides a sphere in radial (r), polar (θ) and azimuthal (ϕ) directions. It uses binary subdivisions in the radial direction to prevent sphoxel elongation as r increases, and is bound by near and far spheres.
summary: The Spherical Binoctree is a spatial partitioning structure for omnidirectional volume rendering that prevents radial sphoxel elongation through binary radial subdivision.
